\version "2.24.0"

\header {
  title = "Élégie"
  subtitle = "für Violoncello und Klavier"
  composer = "N. N."
  tagline = ##f
}

cello = \relative c {
  \clef bass
  \key g \minor
  \time 4/4
  \tempo "Andante cantabile" 4 = 76

  % Takt 1-4 (Thema Teil 1)
  d'2(\p c8 bes a g |
  fis2. g8 a |
  bes4. c8 d4 g, |
  a2.) r4 |

  % Takt 5-8 (Thema Teil 2 nach B-Dur)
  d2( c8 bes a g |
  es'2. d8 c |
  bes4. c8 d c bes a |
  bes2.) r4 |

  % Takt 9-12 (Mittelteil / Steigerung)
  \clef tenor
  c'4.(\mf\< d8 es f g a |
  bes4. a8 g fis g a |
  bes2\f\> a8 g fis g |
  d2.\p) r4 |

  % Takt 13-16 (Reprise & Ausklang)
  \clef bass
  bes2(\p c8 bes a g |
  es2. c4 |
  d2(^\markup { \italic "rit." } fis |
  g,1)\pp\fermata \bar "|."
}

pianoRH = \relative c' {
  \clef treble
  \key g \minor
  \time 4/4

  % Takt 1-4
  r8 d(\p g bes d g, bes d,) |
  r8 c( d fis c d fis c) |
  r8 bes( d g r bes, d g) |
  r8 a,( d fis d' c a fis) |

  % Takt 5-8
  r8 d( g bes d g, bes d,) |
  r8 c( g' c es c g c,) |
  r8 d( f bes r c, f a) |
  r8 d,( f bes d f, d bes) |

  % Takt 9-12
  r8 g'(\mf c es r a, c f) |
  r8 bes,( d g r a, c fis) |
  r8 bes,( d g r g, bes es) |
  r8 a,( c fis a fis c a) |

  % Takt 13-16
  r8 d,(\p g bes r es, g c) |
  r8 c,( es g r a, c fis) |
  r8 bes,( d g) <a, c fis>2 |
  <bes d g>1\fermata \bar "|."
}

pianoLH = \relative c {
  \clef bass
  \key g \minor
  \time 4/4

  % Takt 1-4
  g2. g'4 |
  fis,2. d'4 |
  g,2 bes, |
  d1 |

  % Takt 5-8
  g2. g'4 |
  c,2. c'4 |
  f,2 f, |
  bes1 |

  % Takt 9-12
  es,2 f |
  g2 d |
  es2 c |
  d1 |

  % Takt 13-16
  g,2 c |
  es,2 c |
  d1 |
  <g,, d' g>1\fermata \bar "|."
}

\score {
  <<
    \new Staff = "celloStaff" \with {
      instrumentName = "Violoncello"
      shortInstrumentName = "Vc."
      midiInstrument = "cello"
    } {
      \cello
    }
    \new PianoStaff = "pianoStaff" \with {
      instrumentName = "Klavier"
      shortInstrumentName = "Kl."
    } <<
      \new Staff = "rh" \with {
        midiInstrument = "acoustic grand"
      } {
        \pianoRH
      }
      \new Staff = "lh" \with {
        midiInstrument = "acoustic grand"
      } {
        \pianoLH
      }
    >>
  >>
  \layout {
    \context {
      \Score
      \override SpacingSpanner.base-shortest-duration = #(ly:make-moment 1/16)
    }
  }
  \midi { }
}
